title: nhandiroba scandens
intro: Nhandiroba scandens, commonly known as the "Monkey's Robe", is a species of flowering plant in the family Malpighiaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its reported health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and fever, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Nhandiroba scandens include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as its ability to inhibit the growth of certain microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
